name: ghost-nexora-bot
description: Ghost Nexora Bot - multi-platform bot runtime, economy, subbots and Next.js web

scripts.build: npm run assets:waifus && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.v2:contracts: npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/platform-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/core && npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/runtime && node scripts/platform-contracts-v2-smoke.mjs
scripts.v2:whatsapp-adapter: npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/platform-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/bot && node scripts/whatsapp-adapter-v2-smoke.mjs
scripts.v2:ui-compat: npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/bot && node scripts/v2-phase2-ui-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-ui-compat-audit.mjs
scripts.v2:providers: npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/bot && node scripts/v2-phase3-provider-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-phase3-provider-http-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-phase3-provider-lease-smoke.mjs
scripts.v2:telegram: npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/platform-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/bot && node scripts/v2-phase4-telegram-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-phase4-telegram-audit.mjs
scripts.v2:discord: npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/platform-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@ghostnexora/bot && node scripts/v2-phase5-discord-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-phase5-discord-rest-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-phase5-discord-gateway-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-phase5-discord-runtime-smoke.mjs && node scripts/v2-phase5-discord-audit.mjs
